subject: AI-human collaboration context archive

preferred_primary_site.role: User-preferred primary site; GitHub is the backup.

date_note: Source labels of 2026-10-21 are preserved; labels do not independently verify conversation timestamps.

provenance_policy.direct_user_statement: Statements and preferences explicitly supplied by Artemis for this compilation.
provenance_policy.observed_conversation: Only actions and statements visible in the current conversation; no assumed access to older raw chats.
provenance_policy.archive_report: Claims reported in archived documents, not independently verified by their mere publication.
provenance_policy.interpretation: Revisable inference with concrete cited examples, not a psychometric finding.

offline_tool.scope: Earlier concise profile snapshot only; provide the manifest and new documents separately for full context.

summary.fa: صفحهٔ ورود و فهرست اسناد، روایت‌ها و نامه‌ها با حفظ متن قبلی.
